mainEntity.name: How do I know people actually want the product AI helped me create?

acceptedAnswer.text: Validate the customer problem before spending time polishing AI-generated content. Begin with interviews, existing customer questions, search behavior, competitor reviews, or a small test offer, then use AI to synthesize patterns and identify unanswered questions. Community discussions about AI tools repeatedly emphasize learning what users actually need before adding features. Key factors: recurring pain, current workaround, urgency, willingness to act, and access to buyers. Practical guidance: ask open questions, avoid pitching too early, preserve direct customer language, and compare feedback from several people rather than relying on one enthusiastic response.
acceptedAnswer.description: Validate the problem before polishing the product. Talk with potential users, review their current workarounds, identify recurring pain, and test a small offer or waitlist. Use AI to organize feedback, but rely on real behavior—sign-ups, usage, pilot participation, or payment—rather than compliments alone.
